description: Every infinite structure in a countable language has a subset not definable even with finite parameters from its entire carrier.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Definability.exists_undefinable_subset.{u} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type u}
  [L.Structure M] [Infinite M] [Countable L.Symbols] : ∃ s, ¬Set.univ.Definable₁ L s
